definitions: To arrive on the ground or other surface after moving through the air.
To bring an aircraft or spacecraft down to the ground or other surface.
To succeed in obtaining or achieving something desirable, especially a job or a prize.
To cause someone to be in a particular difficult or unpleasant situation.
To hit or strike someone or something, especially with a punch or a blow.
examples: The plane will land in an hour.
The punch landed squarely on his jaw.
The decision landed them in trouble.
